mission.title: Mission
mission.subtitle: Energie, Bergbau, KI und Nachhaltigkeit verbinden
mission.description: EnergieMIND verbindet Energiesysteme, Bergbausysteme, KI-Koordination und Nachhaltigkeit zu einem intelligenten Energieinfrastrukturkonzept.
mission.pageIntro: EnergieMIND ist darauf ausgelegt, die Interaktion von Energie- und Bergbausystemen zu transformieren.
mission.visionText: Eine Zukunft, in der jede Joule Rechenenergie intelligent koordiniert wird.
mission.approachText: Wir kombinieren Energiemonitoring, KI-gestützte Optimierung, Bergbauwärmerückgewinnung und nachhaltige Infrastruktur.

items.wastedEnergy: Energie wird bei Erzeugung, Verteilung und Verbrauch verschwendet.
items.wastedHeat: Bergbauwärme wird verschwendet, während Gebäude Heizung benötigen.
items.infrastructure: Infrastruktur benötigt bessere Koordination zwischen Energie, Wärme und Rechenleistung.

platformOverview.pageIntro: An overview of the EnergieMIND platform — energy intelligence, monitoring, optimization and infrastructure coordination in one coordinated layer.
platformOverview.section1Text: EnergieMIND is designed as a coordination platform connecting energy monitoring, mining operations, heat recovery and AI-assisted optimization into a single operational view.
platformOverview.section2Text: The platform architecture supports real-time dashboards, operational metrics and pattern analysis across connected energy and mining infrastructure.
platformOverview.section3Text: EnergieMIND is being prepared for pilot deployments across hotels, commercial buildings, agricultural facilities and industrial sites — with modular integration into existing infrastructure.

security.pageIntro: Security and operational readiness considerations for the EnergieMIND platform — from infrastructure design through deployment preparation.
security.section1Text: EnergieMIND is being developed with security-conscious architecture for monitoring systems, data flows and operational interfaces across connected infrastructure.
security.section2Text: Infrastructure design considers operational resilience, access controls and secure coordination between energy systems, mining hardware and heating infrastructure.
security.section3Text: EnergieMIND has completed an independent launch readiness assessment through Preflight Audit, covering platform security, infrastructure, operational readiness, technology architecture and deployment readiness.
